cs.t: I've stuck with buffalo for the last ... 6-8 years, and I have yet to see any of my buffalo routers need a restart, let alone die permanently.  Coming with (a customized) DD-WRT out of the box is just a bonus, at that point. They may not have the greatest wifi range in the world, but I haven't found a router to beat them at stability.
